items.text: Incorporated Round 3 decisions into conclusion: (1) Token bucket algorithm for rate limiting — added Finding 17 with capacity/refill_rate state model and industry precedent; (2) Full snapshot push for policy cache invalidation — added Finding 18 noting atomic cache replacement and scale boundary; (3) Segment-count scoring for access control specificity — updated Finding 12 with the 3/2/1 point scoring formula and tie-breaking rule.

Removed three 'depends on Round 3' limitations that are now resolved. Added one new limitation acknowledging that full-snapshot push will need migration to incremental deltas at scale. All previously settled decisions from Rounds 1 and 2 remain unchanged.

Updated Actions to reflect settled algorithms: Action 1 (proto schemas) now specifies token bucket fields and segment-count scoring fields; Action 3 (discovery decorator) now specifies token bucket rate limiting and segment-count access control in sender-side cache; Action 4 (policy API) now specifies all three enforcement algorithms in receiver middleware.

Remaining gaps are implementation-level, not architectural: ring buffer implementation details (in-memory vs on-disk, thread safety), pruning SQL performance at scale, and google.protobuf.Any integration testing. These are appropriately scoped for the execute items to resolve during implementation. The testability score remains at 2 because test strategies depend on implementation choices in the execute items.
